lean.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (f : X → ℝ),
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ →
    ∀ {M : ℝ},
      (∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂μ, |f x| ≤ M) →
        ∫ (x : X), f x ∂μ = 0 →
          have ν := fun e => μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (1 + e * f x);
          (∀ᶠ (e : ℝ) in nhds 0, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ν e) ∧ InformationTheory.klDiv (ν e) μ < ⊤) ∧
            (fun e => (InformationTheory.klDiv (ν e) μ).toReal - e ^ 2 * ((∫ (x : X), f x ^ 2 ∂μ) / 2)) =o[nhds 0]
              fun e => e ^ 2
approved_definition_context: withDensity constructs the measure with the given nonnegative extended-real density relative to the reference measure. ENNReal.ofReal sends negative inputs to zero. The real value of an extended-real divergence is an ordinary divergence only when finiteness is known.
